name: На рекорд: мат (3)
description:
If your king is checkmated, the game is lost. That's not what we want!

Fortunately, it is often possible tho prevent mate. It is superimportant that you know how to this. That’s why, in this Record-breaker, you have to solve puzzles with all the defensive tricks you have learned so far. It is up to you to decide which method you use to prevent checkmate.

If you make a mistake, it is 'game over' - just like in a real chess game...
